name: energybot-embed
description: Widget embebible + API para capturar leads y derivar a WhatsApp.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,widget -c blue,green "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix widget run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix widget run build && npm --prefix api run build && mkdir -p api/dist/public && cp -r widget/dist/* api/dist/public/
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix widget install
